title: Lake Eustis Museum of Art

services.name: Kid's Art Summer Camp
services.desc: is the perfect opportunity for young artists to explore their creativity and unleash their potential. We offer a wide range of exciting art activities and techniques, such as painting, drawing, sculpting, and many more. Our goal is to help each camper develop their artistic skills and confidence while having fun and making new friends. Whether your child is a beginner or an experienced artist, our summer art camp is a great way to encourage their passion for art. Classes are designed for children 6-12 years of age. services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: Join us for the opening reception Friday, May 1, 2026 from 5pm to 7pm, where you can admire stunning artwork, engage in conversation with the artists, and enjoy some delicious refreshments. "Beyond the Ordinary," features an amazing collection from the Pastel Society of Central Florida. You'll enjoy stunning artwork from 15 local artists, each piece with its own unique story. Come and dive into this visual delight-you won't want to miss it!
